title: Inventory of Accelerate unsafe claims and promotions

plan_observations: mock capability/inference and pseudo-CID behavior in accelerate legacy paths

confirmed_defects.title: MockWorker reports cuda/openvino available without probing hardware
confirmed_defects.unsafe_claim: Hardware capability claim (cuda=True, openvino=True) originates from an inlined MockWorker rather than live probe evidence.

production_reachability.via: Package public core group resolves ipfs_accelerate_py from .ipfs_accelerate; MCP acceleration tools and CLI construct the class on production request paths.

counterexample_seed.scenario: Instantiate ipfs_accelerate_py({}, {}) on a host without CUDA/OpenVINO; MockWorker.test_hardware still returns cuda=True and openvino=True, and get_capabilities exposes those bits.
counterexample_seed.expected_illegal_promotion: simulated hardware support -> production capability/supported claim
counterexample_seed.mutation_oracle: Flip MockWorker.test_hardware cuda to False; production routing that previously admitted cuda endpoints must fail closed or become Unavailable.

confirmed_defects.unsafe_claim: Content identity is claimed via hashlib.sha256(...).hexdigest() labeled as a CID without multihash/CIDv1 encoding.
call_flow_path: queue/cache keys treated as content identifiers

counterexample_seed.scenario: Call queue([model], ["hello"]); resulting key is 64 hex chars, not a decodable CIDv0/v1.
counterexample_seed.expected_illegal_promotion: unchecked raw hash -> content identity / CID claim
